# Proficiency Scale

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProficiencyScale>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A framework for rating proficiency in any competency domain — language, skill, or knowledge (CEFR, ILR, ACTFL, Dreyfus, NIH, Bloom's, SOLO, assessed, self-reported). A domain-neutral value vocabulary carried by [`gmeow:proficiencyScale`](../properties/gmeow-proficiencyScale.md), [`gmeow:skillProficiencyScale`](../properties/gmeow-skillProficiencyScale.md), [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale`](../properties/gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyScale.md), and [`gmeow:levelScale`](../properties/gmeow-levelScale.md). Minted in kernel so expertise, languages, and cognition reuse it without a cross-slice dependency cycle ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for naming a rating framework that several competency axes share — language (CEFR/ILR/ACTFL), applied skill (Dreyfus/NIH), or knowledge depth (Bloom's/SOLO/native) — referenced from a proficiency relator's scale role without committing any one slice to a canonical framework ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-framework subclasses (frameworks are individuals of this class) and avoid using it for an attained rating itself; the level a proficiency reaches is a [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md), while this class is the ruler it is read against.

### How to use

- Mint each framework as an individual of [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md) in its own domain slice (languages, expertise, cognition) and cite it from a proficiency relator's scale role ([`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale`](../properties/gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyScale.md), [`gmeow:skillProficiencyScale`](../properties/gmeow-skillProficiencyScale.md)); record cross-framework correspondence in an alignment ledger, never as an OWL axiom ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
